realModel.scope: Unmodified signed RC18 Release workflow artifact, subsequently matched to the public ZIP digest; isolated project; configured coordinator, DeepSeek worker and verifier; governed tools and actual HTTP. No injected Tool Results.

wireSummary.scope: Passive net.fetch shape/status observation; native requests and responses unchanged. One request had no response status at the sample boundary; not claimed successful.

signedUi.scope: Unmodified downloaded signed Mac application with isolated data/profile and synthetic history/memory; no live credentials, tool execution or long-term acceptance.
checks: 52px header with SVG Bot settings entry opens Settings directly
Published Bot settings saves a generated-avatar identity color using the real local profile
Overview and saved Memory remain readable in right sidebar
Chat uses named Bot composer and contained synthetic assistant replies; real-turn details/streaming are covered by source packet, not this seed
Signed application renders saved avatar identity tint in actual assistant bubbles
Published RC18 updater checks real Beta feed with no downgrade offered

oldUpdater.scope: Actual unmodified signed RC17 application and production updater discover and download RC18 via real HTTP. Test-only cache isolation and disabling automatic Squirrel handoff prevent replacing the daily installation; installer execution is not covered.

npm.scope: Public fixed versions and dist-tags; real isolated npm install with postinstall download, CLI version and binary hashes. Global npm and user data untouched.

limits: Source 180 screenshots and 9 actual package/update/real-task screenshots are implementer self-review, not independent review.

Small isolated real task does not establish arbitrary-project or long-term performance.
Windows/Linux interactive installation, full screen reader and Squirrel installer handoff were not performed.
Signed workflow Mac ZIP and the independently downloaded public ZIP have the same SHA-256; application files were not modified.
All 14 public assets were independently downloaded, including the previously tested Mac artifact.
Daily installed application and user data were not modified; credential copies removed and owned test applications exited.
Rollback requires a complete pre-upgrade backup because old versions may reject new coordination journal events.
